The residence

Five rooms, three master suites and a balcony to the sea

According to the broker, this is a five-room mini penthouse, three of the rooms master suites, on 135 sqm built with a 20 sqm balcony, on a high floor of a luxury building in Nofei Yam.1,2 It has two balconies, one facing the sea, and the broker highlights its privacy and sea view.1,3

The apartment was designed by an architect, with quality parquet throughout, a luxury kitchen and custom carpentry.4 It comes with two separate parking spaces prepared for EV charging and a storage room, and the building has a gym and a guard.3,5

The rent was not published. Listings for five-room units and mini penthouses of 110 to 140 sqm in new and boutique buildings in Nofei Yam and Lamed HaHadasha ask NIS 115 to 150 per sqm, or about NIS 15,500 to 20,250 a month for 135 sqm. That is a computed market range, not a valuation.6,7

The location

Nofei Yam, between HaGush HaGadol and the coastal park

The coastal park promenade opened in September 2023 and runs about 2 km along the cliff, from Tel Baruch beach in the south to Tzuk beach in the north, inside a 500-dunam nature park and alongside a bike path.13,14 Madlan content published by Globes describes Nofei Yam as a short walk from the beach.15

At least two small shopping centers operate among the neighborhood's complexes, though there is no lively shopping street; several kindergartens and a school operate within HaGush HaGadol.15,16 Since November 2023 a pedestrian and cycle bridge with lifts has crossed Einstein Street between Nofei Yam and Lamed HaHadasha, and the municipal country club of Plan Lamed lies south of the street.16,17

West of the neighborhood, the Sde Dov district is being built on the airport that closed in 2019, with about 16,000 apartments. By February 2026 developers had sold more than 1,500 of them, and most are expected to be ready within 3 to 6 years.18,19 Car access relies mainly on Levi Eshkol Boulevard and Einstein Street, and the Einstein and Namir junction is congested at peak hours.16

Planning

What is planned nearby

Published plans and works, and what they may mean for a buyer or tenant. Based on published reports; not a substitute for a check with the planning authority.

  • Einstein 15 project10,15

    A 30-floor tower with 180 homes on Einstein Street, the neighborhood's southern edge; Madlan expects completion in mid-2028. Until then, expect construction work and site traffic nearby. The distance from the building depends on the exact address.31

  • Einstein 1 project15

    179 apartments. Construction was planned to start in 2025, per Madlan content published in Globes in 2024; current status not verified.

  • Nofei Yam North32

    191 vacant dunams between the neighborhood and Propes Street. A 2021 plan allows 1,530 homes but no permits were issued; in March 2025 the permit freeze was extended by three years for re-planning, and heights could rise from 15 to 45 floors. Views to the north may change in the long term.

  • Sde Dov center plan33

    7,128 homes in towers of 20 and 45 floors. Objections were rejected in February 2025; the skyline to the west and south-west will change, and works will continue for years.

  • Plan 3700, north-west Tel Aviv34

    About 12,000 homes north of Propes Street: a large new supply and long-term construction north of the neighborhood.

Before you decide

What to check before signing

The questions a careful tenant asks about the unit and the building, and the documents to obtain.

  • Is the unit still available, and what is the rent?
  • What is the building's address, the floor and the number of floors, and which way does each balcony face?
  • Is the guard on site 24/7 or at set hours, and what does the va'ad bayit cover (gym, guard, cleaning, gardening)?
  • What are the current va'ad bayit and bi-monthly arnona, and what area is charged?
  • Is an EV charger installed or only prepared, who pays for installation and electricity, and has the house committee approved it?
  • Are the 2 parking spaces registered to the unit, separate and underground? How big is the storage room?
  • Is there a mamad in the apartment?
  • What lease term, extension option and indexation are offered, which securities are required, and is any rent payable upfront?
  • Who pays the broker fee, and how much is it?
  • Is the apartment furnished, and which appliances stay?
  • What can be built in front of the sea-facing balcony?
  • Are pets allowed, and is there a Shabbat elevator?
  • The draft lease, including guarantees, indexation, option and any upfront payments
  • The unit's latest arnona bill
  • Confirmation of the landlord's rights in the unit and both parking spaces, and the house committee's approval for EV charging
  • A handover record and equipment list

Questions and answers

Questions worth asking

What does the apartment cost per month?
The broker has not published a rent. Based on similar listings in Nofei Yam and Lamed HaHadasha, the market range for 135 sqm is about NIS 15,500 to 20,250 a month, before arnona and the building fee. This is a computation, not a quote.6,7
When can a tenant move in?
The broker gives a flexible entry date; agree the date with her directly.3
What does the building offer?
Per the broker, a gym and a guard. The guard's hours and what the building fee covers were not published.5
Does the Fair Rental Law apply?
Only if the rent does not exceed about NIS 20,000 a month. Then guarantees are capped at 3 months' rent at most, and the landlord's repair duties apply. The computed range for this unit crosses that threshold.35,38
Is the parking EV-ready?
Per the broker, the parking spaces are prepared for charging. Whether a charger is installed, and who pays for installation and electricity, was not stated.3
